content: This product was developed by Pete Johnson in collaboration with Jaime Garcia. It is manufactured at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in Little Havana, Miami, Florida. The brand was created by Pete Johnson, who is the owner of Tatuaje Cigars, Inc., in consultation with Jaime Garcia, the son of José Pepin Garcia. The filler of this cigar, known as the Cabaiguan blend, is composed of a mixture of Nicaraguan tobaccos. The binder is also Nicaraguan, while the wrapper is made from a Connecticut Seed shade-grown Ecuadorian leaf. This combination results in a medium-bodied cigar. This particular cigar was first introduced to the market in 2004 and is available in four different vitolas. This information is referenced from Richard B. Perelman's Perelman's Pocket Cyclopedia of Cigars, 2006 edition, published in 2005, on page 111.
